s33_amphan_wind|1|ERA5.text: We use ERA5 again, at nine in the morning, universal time, on the twentieth of May, as Amphan reached the coast.

s33_amphan_wind|1|twentieth.text: We use ERA5 again, at nine in the morning, universal time, on the twentieth of May, as Amphan reached the coast.

s33_amphan_wind|2|ERA5.text: Remember that ERA5 smooths the storm: its strongest wind near Amphan is only about six tenths of the official estimate, so we use it for the direction of the wind, not its full strength.

s33_amphan_wind|9|ERA5.text: ERA5's wind there was about twenty two point six metres per second, from the south-south-east: u about minus eight point four, and v about plus twenty one.

s33_amphan_wind|11|about minus.text: Together, that's about minus twenty two point four metres per second: onto the land.

s36_nargis_wind|3|kilometres north.text: Going west along the coast there, we move about sixty nine point five kilometres west and ten point eight kilometres north.
